SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd) FROM drilling_operations WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM operation_date) = 2023;
SELECT AVG(price_per_bbl) FROM liftings WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lifting_date) = 2024;
SELECT platform_name, field_id, capacity_bopd FROM platforms WHERE platform_type = 'onshore';
SELECT well_name, field_id, depth_m FROM wells WHERE status = 'shut_in';
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(f.field_id) FROM regions r LEFT JOIN fields f ON r.region_id = f.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id;
SELECT incident_date, field_id, platform_id, severity FROM safety_incidents WHERE incident_type = 'spill';

SELECT w.well_name, SUM(pr.downtime_hours) FROM production_records pr JOIN wells w ON pr.well_id = w.well_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.record_date) = 2024 AND pr.downtime_hours > 0 GROUP BY w.well_id;
SELECT field_name, water_depth_m, status FROM fields WHERE water_depth_m > 100;
SELECT f.field_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM employees e JOIN fields f ON e.field_id = f.field_id GROUP BY f.field_id;
SELECT incident_type, COUNT(*), SUM(lost_time_days) FROM safety_incidents WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM incident_date) = 2024 GROUP BY incident_type;
SELECT contract_number, volume_bbl, price_per_bbl FROM sales_contracts WHERE product_type = 'crude';
SELECT well_name, spud_date, completion_date FROM wells WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM spud_date) = 2022;
SELECT w.well_name, SUM(oc.amount_usd) FROM operating_costs oc JOIN wells w ON oc.well_id = w.well_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oc.cost_date) = 2023 GROUP BY w.well_id;
SELECT tank_name, current_level_bbl, capacity_bbl FROM storage_tanks WHERE (current_level_bbl/capacity_bbl) > 0.8;
SELECT w.well_name, w.status FROM platform_wells pw JOIN wells w ON pw.well_id = w.well_id WHERE pw.platform_id = 1;
SELECT AVG(temperature_c) FROM reservoir_data WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL;
SELECT incident_date, field_id, lost_time_days FROM safety_incidents WHERE incident_type = 'LTI';
SELECT field_name, estimated_reserves_mboe, status FROM fields WHERE estimated_reserves_mboe > 1000;
SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM operating_costs WHERE cost_category = 'chemicals' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cost_date) = 2024;
SELECT p.pipeline_name, f.field_name FROM pipelines p JOIN fields f ON p.origin_field_id = f.field_id;
SELECT f.field_name, AVG(w.depth_m) FROM wells w JOIN fields f ON w.field_id = f.field_id WHERE w.depth_m IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.field_id;
SELECT tank_name, capacity_bbl, current_level_bbl FROM storage_tanks WHERE product_type = 'crude';

SELECT f.field_name, SUM(oc.amount_usd) FROM operating_costs oc JOIN fields f ON oc.field_id = f.field_id WHERE oc.cost_category = 'labor' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oc.cost_date) = 2024 GROUP BY f.field_id;
SELECT well_name, spud_date, completion_date, (completion_date - spud_date) as drilling_days FROM wells WHERE completion_date IS NOT NULL;
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(f.field_id), SUM(f.estimated_reserves_mboe) FROM regions r LEFT JOIN fields f ON r.region_id = f.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id;
SELECT incident_date, field_id, severity FROM safety_incidents WHERE incident_type = 'near_miss';
SELECT contract_number, delivery_point, volume_bbl FROM sales_contracts WHERE delivery_point IS NOT NULL;
SELECT platform_name, platform_type, field_id FROM platforms WHERE platform_type IN ('offshore_fixed', 'FPSO', 'jackup', 'semisub');
SELECT contract_number, start_date, end_date, volume_bbl FROM sales_contracts WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) = 2024 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2024;
SELECT field_name, discovery_date, estimated_reserves_mboe FROM fields WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM discovery_date) = 2020;
SELECT well_name, field_id FROM wells WHERE status = 'drilling';

SELECT p.platform_name, SUM(pr.oil_bbl) FROM production_records pr JOIN wells w ON pr.well_id = w.well_id JOIN platform_wells pw ON w.well_id = pw.well_id JOIN platforms p ON pw.platform_id = p.platform_id GROUP BY p.platform_id;
SELECT region_name, basin_name, country FROM regions WHERE basin_name IS NOT NULL;
SELECT well_name, latitude, longitude, field_id FROM wells WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL;
SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM operating_costs WHERE cost_category = 'overhead' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cost_date) = 2024;
SELECT pipeline_name, diameter_mm, length_km FROM pipelines WHERE diameter_mm > 500;

SELECT f.field_name, oc.cost_category, SUM(oc.amount_usd) FROM operating_costs oc JOIN fields f ON oc.field_id = f.field_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oc.cost_date) = 2023 GROUP BY f.field_id, oc.cost_category;
